page_title: OSA 2-1 GET | Osasuna v Getafe 03/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Javier Alberola has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Kike Barja (Osasuna) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+2' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ruben Garcia walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jorge Herrando (Osasuna).
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
90' 2 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the left side of the goal. He makes it 2:1.
90' The linesman points to the corner flag, Osasuna are going to take it.
88' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) gets on the end of a cross but produces a tame shot from the edge of the area which goes well wide of the right post.
87' Getafe take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
87' Luis Milla (Getafe) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Corner kick. Getafe will have an opportunity.
87' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
86' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Getafe.
86' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Coba da Costa (Getafe) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
84' Substitution. Victor Munoz is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
82' Yvan Neyou (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
81' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) unleashes a promising shot towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but David Soria thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
78' Coba da Costa (Getafe) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
76' Wonderful movement by Osasuna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juanmi (Getafe) is coming onto the pitch as Borja Mayoral cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Alex Sancris is replaced by Coba da Costa (Getafe).
72' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
68' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' Substitution. Raul Garcia (Osasuna) has come on for Juan Cruz.
66' Yvan Neyou (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola had an easy-decision to make.
64' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Luis Milla (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
64' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
63' Yvan Neyou (Getafe) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

59' Osasuna slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
55' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna). Javier Alberola saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
54' A quickly taken corner by Getafe.
54' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
50' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) drills a first-timer from the edge of the box that flies towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper stops the shot from going into his goal net with a quick save.
46' Half-time substitution. Mario Martin (Getafe) will not participate anymore and Yvan Neyou is coming on.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives a chance to Djene and Abdel Abqar (Getafe) is off.
46' Alessio Lisci has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ruben Garcia comes on the pitch for Lucas Torro (Osasuna).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+6' Abdel Abqar (Getafe) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the left post, but Sergio Herrera pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.

45+3' 1 - 1 Brilliant finish! Abel Bretones (Osasuna) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Victor Munoz, then produced a nice strike into the top left corner. The score is 1:1.
45+1' Getafe showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
45+1' We will have 7 min. of added time.
45' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:3.
42' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Osasuna, play can continue.

41' Play continues despite the shouts by some Osasuna players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Javier Alberola interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.

40' What an opportunity! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the resulting free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
39' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) will take the free kick.
39' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
38' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Mario Martin (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Javier Alberola and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
35' PENALTY APPEAL after Ante Budimir (Osasuna) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
29' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) plays a one-two with Jon Moncayola, but the move breaks down.
29' A pass by Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
28' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is penalised for holding. Javier Alberola signals a set piece.
26' Osasuna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
23' 0 - 1 What a goal! Luis Milla plays it to Borja Mayoral (Getafe), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Sergio Herrera low into the middle of the net. 0:1.
23' Mario Martin (Getafe) is adjudged offside.
20' A pass from Alex Sancris (Getafe) is intercepted by Sergio Herrera and the move breaks down.

19' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Getafe are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
17' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Abdel Abqar (Getafe) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
16' The ball goes behind for a corner. Getafe will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
14' David Soria (Getafe) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
11' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by David Soria.
6' Diego Rico (Getafe) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
5' Getafe fail to score from a corner as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaps to collect the ball.
4' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Getafe force their opponents to concede a corner.
4' Abdel Abqar (Getafe) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Osasuna will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Javier Alberola.
